spec.name: Trend v28
spec.notes: Classic trend signal on trailing returns. Weekly rebalance.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.9, annual return 6%, maximum drawdown 7%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy universe is explicitly defined as 'survivors', which introduces significant survivorship bias. By excluding companies that delisted or failed during the backtest period, the performance metrics are artificially inflated. Furthermore, the research log indicates a very small number of trials (4), suggesting the strategy has not been rigorously stress-tested against overfitting or parameter sensitivity. Given the reliance on a survivor-only dataset, the claimed Sharpe ratio of 1.9 is likely unreliable. I recommend moving this to paper trading to validate performance on a live, non-survivorship-biased universe before committing real capital.
